decisions.rationale: origin has distinct_count 3 and time_hour has distinct_count 4341; 3 times 4341 approximates row_count 13014, so a station recorded roughly once per hour over the window makes origin plus time_hour the smallest column set that plausibly identifies one row.
dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 13014, so no exact duplicate rows were observed in bronze and no row-dropping dedupe step is proposed.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are all flagged is_airbyte_metadata true, identifying them as Airbyte capture-tool columns rather than observational weather data.
wind_gust has null_rate 0.745505 (9702 of 13014 rows), making it sparsely populated; it is retained as a nullable numeric column rather than imputed or dropped.
pressure has null_rate 0.114953 (1496 of 13014 rows); it is retained as a nullable numeric column rather than imputed.
year, month, day, and hour all land as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample and the min/max bounds are whole numbers (e.g. month 1.0-6.0, day 1.0-31.0, hour 0.0-23.0), so each is cast to INTEGER.

time_hour lands as VARCHAR but all 10 sample_values are consistently ISO8601 instants ending in Z (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00Z), so it is cast to TIMESTAMP representing the UTC instant per the operator context.

purpose: This table holds cleaned hourly ASOS weather observations for the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering January through June 2013, feeding downstream joins to flight-level tables keyed by origin and time.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather conditions to flights or other hourly events; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming zero or average values, and should be aware wind_gust is null in roughly three-quarters of rows.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as capture artifacts; wind_gust (null_rate 0.745505) and pressure (null_rate 0.114953) retain substantial nulls that this cleanup does not impute or resolve; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
